# magpie-free-pi Free models for Magpie, funded by ads — no API key, no card, one GitHub sign-in. **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Flash, GLM 5.3 Flash and Particle, free and unlimited in [Magpie](https://usemagpie.ai).** ![CI](https://github.com/wawaTuna/magpie-free-pi/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/magpie-free-pi)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/magpie-free-pi) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg) **[Quick start](#quick-start) · [Multiple accounts](#multiple-accounts) · [How it works](#how-it-works) · [Privacy](#privacy) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)** ## Quick start **1 · Install.** ```bash magpie plugin add github:wawaTuna/magpie-free-pi ```
Other install routes ```bash # Local clone / folder (loaded in place) git clone https://github.com/wawaTuna/magpie-free-pi magpie plugin add ./magpie-free-pi ```
**2 · Sign in.** (Accepts free-pi's terms — read [Privacy](#privacy) first.) ```bash magpie plugin login free-pi # GitHub device flow, 90-day token ``` **3 · Verify.** ```bash magpie provider test free-pi # one real chat call magpie quota # today's remaining budget ``` Models are then available to every agent as e.g. `free-pi/deepseek-v4.1-flash`. Sample quota output: ``` $ magpie quota free-pi · free-pi (young) · chenbeigao (free-pi) subscription · today · 15000 / 15000 credits left · ↻ tomorrow 08:00 $1.1250 left today ``` ## What you get - **Free Unlimited models cost nothing.** The models free-pi marks Free Unlimited (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Flash, GLM 5.3 Flash, Particle at the time of writing) never touch your budget. - **Everything else runs on a daily budget.** 15,000 credits (≈ $1.125) per account per day, refilled at 00:00 UTC. Metered models (DeepSeek V4 Pro, GPT-6 series, Kimi, …) deduct their real upstream cost × a catalogue multiplier. - **The model list is live.** It comes from free-pi's own catalogue endpoint, so models appear and disappear as free-pi changes them — no plugin update needed. - **Quota is visible.** Remaining budget per account shows in `magpie quota`, the Providers UI, and Magpie's routing decisions. ## Multiple accounts Each free-pi account is a GitHub account with its own daily budget, and Magpie keeps several accounts per provider natively. This plugin stores a sign-in under your free-pi handle, so signing in again with a *different* GitHub account **adds** an account instead of replacing the first: ```bash magpie plugin login free-pi # repeat with another GitHub account ``` Magpie then fails over between accounts on its own (a rate limit or a refused token moves the request to the next account) and weighs them by the quota this plugin reports. Two accounts = 2 × 15,000 credits a day for metered models; Free Unlimited stays free on every account. The same sign-ins also join a shared on-disk account pool (`~/.free-pi/agent/`, 0600) used by the sibling project [dsh-free-pi](https://github.com/wawaTuna/dsh-free-pi) and by the standalone proxy in the free-pi-plugins monorepo — sign in once per machine, use everywhere. ## How it works Magpie provider plugins are OpenCode v1 plugins; this one is a thin adapter over a small shared core: - **Provider declaration.** `config` registers the provider as `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible` with `api: https://api.freepi.ai/v1`. - **Sign-in.** `auth` offers free-pi's GitHub device flow as an oauth method, plus a paste-a-JWT fallback for a token you already have. - **The loader's fetch is the reverse proxy.** free-pi's backend requires three things a normal OpenAI client doesn't send — `Authorization: Bearer `, a stable per-install `x-session-id`, and `x-client-version` (the server blocks clients below a minimum version). The fetch injects all three, per account. - **Live catalogue.** `provider.models` maps free-pi's unauthenticated `/client-version` catalogue to Magpie's model shape (upstream has no `/v1/models`). - **Quota reporting.** `auth.usage` reads the account's `/me` record and reports today's window (used / 15,000 credits, refill time, USD left). A standalone OpenAI-compatible proxy with the same core (for hosts without a plugin system) lives in the free-pi-plugins monorepo. ## Privacy free-pi is funded by ads **and by training on session data**. Its consent text — which you accept when you sign in — says your coding sessions (prompts, code, files, model responses) are saved as traces, used to train models, and may be shared or sold to third parties; the ad provider receives excerpts of your recent conversation to pick ads. Full terms: https://freepi.ai/terms Only sign in with accounts and code you are comfortable with that trade. This applies to everything you send through free-pi, from any host. ## FAQ #### When does the budget refill? Daily at 00:00 UTC. `magpie quota` shows the exact countdown per account. #### Is "Free Unlimited" permanent? No — it's free-pi's promotion and can end at any time. Metered models keep working on the daily budget either way. #### My token expired. What now? Tokens last ~90 days. Magpie marks the account; run `magpie plugin login free-pi` again — nothing else to redo. #### Could free-pi block this kind of client? Its backend officially serves free-pi's own terminal client. This plugin talks to the same backend the same way, but free-pi could tighten its checks (for example, require live ad sessions). ## Contributing Issues and PRs are welcome. ## License MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). *Unofficial plugin. Not affiliated with free-pi, Magpie, or the model providers. "free-pi" and model names belong to their respective owners.*

# magpie-free-pi 给 Magpie 用的免费模型，靠广告养活 —— 不要 API key、不用绑卡，GitHub 登录一次即可。 **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、DeepSeek V4 Flash、GLM 5.3 Flash、Particle，在 [Magpie](https://usemagpie.ai) 里免费无限用。** ![CI](https://github.com/wawaTuna/magpie-free-pi/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/magpie-free-pi)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/magpie-free-pi) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg) **[快速开始](#快速开始) · [多账号](#多账号) · [原理](#原理) · [隐私](#隐私) · [English](README.md)** ## 快速开始 **1 · 安装。** ```bash magpie plugin add github:wawaTuna/magpie-free-pi ```
其他安装方式 ```bash # 本地克隆 / 文件夹（原地加载） git clone https://github.com/wawaTuna/magpie-free-pi magpie plugin add ./magpie-free-pi ```
**2 · 登录。**（登录即接受 free-pi 的条款 —— 先读 [隐私](#隐私) 一节。） ```bash magpie plugin login free-pi # GitHub 设备流，令牌有效期 90 天 ``` **3 · 验证。** ```bash magpie provider test free-pi # 真实调一发 magpie quota # 看今天还剩多少额度 ``` 之后各 agent 就能以 `free-pi/deepseek-v4.1-flash` 这样的方式用这些模型。额度输出示例： ``` $ magpie quota free-pi · free-pi (young) · chenbeigao (free-pi) subscription · today · 15000 / 15000 credits left · ↻ tomorrow 08:00 $1.1250 left today ``` ## 你能得到什么 - **免费无限档不花钱。** free-pi 标记为 Free Unlimited 的模型（写作时为 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、DeepSeek V4 Flash、GLM 5.3 Flash、Particle）永远不占用预算。 - **其余模型走每日预算。** 每个账号每天 15,000 点（约 $1.125），UTC 00:00（北京时间 08:00）刷新。扣费模型（DeepSeek V4 Pro、GPT-6 系列、Kimi 等）按真实上游成本 × 目录倍率扣。 - **模型列表是实时的。** 来自 free-pi 自己的目录接口，它增删模型这边立刻跟随，不用更新插件。 - **额度可见。** 每个账号的剩余预算会显示在 `magpie quota`、Providers 界面里，也参与 Magpie 的路由决策。 ## 多账号 每个 free-pi 账号就是一个 GitHub 账号，各有一份每日预算。Magpie 原生支持一个 provider 挂多个账号；这个插件把登录按你的 free-pi 用户名存档，所以换一个 GitHub 账号再登录一次是**新增**账号，而不是替换第一个： ```bash magpie plugin login free-pi # 换另一个 GitHub 账号重复一次 ``` 之后 Magpie 自己在账号间做故障切换（某个账号限流或令牌被拒，请求自动转到下一个），并按本插件上报的额度给账号加权。两个账号 = 扣费模型每天 2 × 15,000 点；免费无限档在每个账号上都免费。 这些登录同时会进入一份本机共享的账号池（`~/.free-pi/agent/`，0600 权限），姊妹项目 [dsh-free-pi](https://github.com/wawaTuna/dsh-free-pi) 和 free-pi-plugins 单体仓库里的独立代理共用它 —— 一台机器上登录一次，处处可用。 ## 原理 Magpie 的 provider 插件是 OpenCode v1 插件形态；这个插件是架在一个小共享核心上的薄适配层： - **Provider 声明。** `config` 把 provider 注册为 `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`，`api: https://api.freepi.ai/v1`。 - **登录。** `auth` 提供 GitHub 设备流作为 oauth 登录法，另有一个粘贴 JWT 的兜底法（适合手头已有令牌）。 - **loader 的 fetch 本身就是反代。** free-pi 后端要求三样普通 OpenAI 客户端不会发的东西 —— `Authorization: Bearer `、每装一份稳定的 `x-session-id`、`x-client-version`（服务器会拦低于最低版本的客户端）—— 这个 fetch 按账号逐个注入。 - **实时目录。** `provider.models` 把 free-pi 无需鉴权的 `/client-version` 目录映射成 Magpie 的模型形态（上游没有 `/v1/models`）。 - **额度上报。** `auth.usage` 读账号的 `/me` 记录，上报今天的窗口（已用 / 15,000 点、刷新时间、剩余美元）。 同一核心还有一个独立的 OpenAI 兼容代理（给没有插件系统的宿主用），在 free-pi-plugins 单体仓库里。 ## 隐私 free-pi 由广告**和用会话数据训练模型**养活。它的同意文本 —— 你登录时即接受 —— 写明：你的编码会话（提示词、代码、文件、模型回复）会被保存为轨迹、用于训练模型，并可能共享或出售给第三方；广告商会拿到你近期对话的摘录来选广告。完整条款：https://freepi.ai/terms 只用你能接受这个交换的账号和代码登录。这一条对你经 free-pi 发送的一切内容都适用，与从哪个宿主用它无关。 ## 常见问题 #### 预算什么时候刷新？ 每天 UTC 00:00。`magpie quota` 会显示每个账号的精确倒计时。 #### "免费无限"是永久的吗？ 不是 —— 这是 free-pi 的限时促销，随时可能结束。结束后扣费模型仍可走每日预算。 #### 令牌过期了怎么办？ 令牌约 90 天有效期。过期后 Magpie 会标记该账号，再跑一次 `magpie plugin login free-pi` 即可，其他什么都不用重做。 #### free-pi 会封这种客户端吗？ 它的后端官方只服务它自己的终端客户端。本插件以同样方式调同一后端，但 free-pi 可能收紧校验（比如要求真实广告会话）。 ## 参与贡献 欢迎提 issue 和 PR。 ## 许可 MIT —— 见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。 *非官方插件。与 free-pi、Magpie 及各模型提供方无隶属关系。"free-pi" 与各模型名称归其各自所有者所有。*
